blocks.heading: What a website project looks like

steps.title: We talk
steps.description: A short conversation about your business, your customers, and what the site has to accomplish. Free, and there is no pitch deck.

steps.title: I design in the browser
steps.description: No static mockups that look nothing like the finished thing. You see real pages on a real URL and give feedback as it comes together.

steps.title: You review
steps.description: We go back and forth until the pages are right. Changes at this stage are normal and expected, not an extra invoice.

steps.title: It ships
steps.description: I handle the domain, hosting, SSL, and search setup, then hand you a site that is live and fast. Most projects launch within a few weeks.

blocks.text: Serving Eugene, Springfield, and Lane County

I live and work in Eugene, Oregon, and most of my clients are within a few miles of downtown. Being local means we can meet in person, and it means I understand who you are selling to. I also work with businesses in Springfield, Cottage Grove, Creswell, and the rest of Lane County, and remotely with clients further afield.
Common questions about working with a Eugene web designer

items.title: How much does a website cost in Eugene?
items.description: Sites start at $500. A simple one-page site for a small business sits near the bottom of that range, and a larger multi-page site with custom features costs more. You get a fixed number before any work starts.

items.title: How long does a website take to build?
items.description: Most small-business sites take two to four weeks from our first conversation to launch. The main variable is how quickly you can get me your content and feedback.

items.title: Do you work with WordPress?
items.description: I build custom sites in code rather than on WordPress, which is what makes them fast and removes the plugin updates and security patching. If you already have a WordPress site I can maintain it or migrate you off it.

items.title: Do I need to handle my own hosting?
items.description: No. I set up the domain, hosting, and SSL certificate and keep them running. You get one point of contact instead of three vendors.

items.title: Will my site show up on Google?
items.description: Every site I build ships with proper page titles, meta descriptions, structured data, a sitemap, and fast load times. That is the technical groundwork Google needs. Ranking also depends on your Google Business Profile and reviews, and I will walk you through both.

items.title: Can you fix or redesign my existing site?
items.description: Yes. Redesigns are a good chunk of my work. I keep the content and rankings you already have and rebuild the parts that are slow, dated, or hard to update.
